hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,subprocess as p,sys;d=sys.stdin.read();c=json.loads(d).get("cwd") or ".";t=p.run(["git","-C",c,"rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();g=os.path.join(t,".claude/hooks/guard.py");sys.exit(p.run([sys.executable,g,sys.argv[1]],input=d,text=True).returncode if t and os.path.isfile(g) else 0)' pre-edit || exit 2
